title: Blind SSRF via webhook URL to cloud metadata
control: egress allow-list + block of link-local/metadata ranges
bypass: DNS rebinding and decimal/octal IP encodings of 169.254.169.254
chain: SSRF to instance metadata -> steal role credentials -> cloud pivot

title: SSRF in PDF/screenshot renderer via embedded resource
sink: HTML/markdown renderer that fetches embedded image/stylesheet URLs
control: renderer network isolation / no outbound from the render sandbox
bypass: redirect from an allowed host to an internal host (open redirect chain)
chain: SSRF -> internal admin endpoint reachable only from the render host

title: IDOR on invoice export by sequential id
sink: GET /export/{id} resolving by id without an owner scope
control: row-level ownership filter injected below the handler
bypass: id in a nested body field the authorization middleware does not inspect
chain: IDOR read of another tenant's invoice -> PII disclosure

title: IDOR write reassigns resource owner
control: server derives owner from the session, ignores client owner_id
bypass: owner_id accepted on PATCH even though PUT is guarded
chain: IDOR write -> reassign ownership -> account/resource takeover

title: Indirect prompt injection via ingested support ticket
sink: agent that summarizes untrusted ticket text with tool access
control: privilege separation: tools authorize the caller, not the model
bypass: instructions hidden in an attachment the classifier did not scan
chain: indirect injection -> tool-driven data exfil to an attacker endpoint

title: System prompt leak via format-confusion
sink: chat endpoint echoing a templated system preamble
control: no secrets in the prompt; preamble carries no standalone capability
bypass: ask for output in a serialization format that dumps the context
chain: system-prompt leak -> maps tool surface -> targeted injection
